getLabel.description: Short name for labels and announcements, such as "Lisbon".

onDecide.description: Called when a card is swiped or decided by button or key.

onUndo.description: Called when the last decision is undone.

onReset.description: Called when all cards come back.

labels.description: Action names on the buttons and drag stamps.

outcomes.description: Past tense of each action for announcements, such as "skipped".
